---
title: "Structural Calculation Report"
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    papersize: a4
    fontsize: 10pt
    geometry:
      - margin=0.75in
    number-sections: true
    # one font family for text AND math (xelatex, Quarto's default engine)
    mainfont: "TeX Gyre Termes"
    mathfont: "TeX Gyre Termes Math"
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \usepackage{etoolbox}
        \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
        \AtBeginEnvironment{longtable}{\small}
        \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
        \setlength{\parskip}{5pt}
        \usepackage{titlesec}
        \titleformat{\section}{\large\bfseries}{\thesection}{0.6em}{}
        \titleformat{\subsection}{\normalsize\bfseries}{\thesubsection}{0.6em}{}
jupyter: python3
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

<!--
Template for written reports. Render from the project root:  quarto render main.qmd
Each section: one cell with the inputs, one cell that prints the report as Markdown.
-->
